description: React component for IP filtering configuration in Mattermost admin console, managing IP filter rules, installation status, and modal interactions.

methods.name: pollInstallationStatus
methods.description: Polls the installation status periodically until it becomes 'stable' or fails after multiple attempts.

methods.name: getInstallationStatus
methods.description: Fetches current installation status and manages saving state accordingly.

methods.name: changeSavingDescription
methods.description: Updates the saving description message displayed to the user.

methods.name: handleEditFilter
methods.description: Handles editing of an IP filter rule.

methods.name: showAddModal
methods.description: Opens modal to add a new IP filter.

methods.name: showEditModal
methods.description: Opens modal to edit an existing IP filter.

methods.name: showConfirmDeleteFilterModal
methods.description: Opens confirmation modal to delete an IP filter.

methods.name: handleDeleteFilter
methods.description: Deletes an IP filter after confirmation.

methods.name: handleAddFilter
methods.description: Adds a new IP filter to the list.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the current IP filter configuration.

methods.name: handleSaveClick
methods.description: Prepares and opens confirmation modal for saving changes.

methods.name: saveBarError
methods.description: Generates error message if current IP is outside of filters.
